architecture.agent_role: select task relation, target task, and intended action
architecture.python_role: materialize the action payload, enforce safety policy, and execute or escalate
architecture.execution_observation: read the stored task back and compare it with the expected result

verified_guard_contracts: CREATE_TASK, UPDATE_TASK, and LINK_TO_TASK Agent proposals are materialized and accepted when safe
an Agent-selected task is accepted when its ID exists anywhere in the retrieved top-k candidate pool
relation and action mismatch escalates to ASK_USER
mail intent and action mismatch escalates to ASK_USER
selected task mismatch escalates to ASK_USER
missing required payload escalates to ASK_USER
due-date reduction, completion, and cancellation retain user approval gates
inbound SET_WAITING is not automatically executed
an escalated proposal does not change the existing task
THREAD_EXACT continues to bypass the Task Context Agent
Agent Action Proposal and Python Safety Guard are separate trace events

cases: different thread context selects SAME_TASK and UPDATE_TASK
equally evidenced candidates return AMBIGUOUS and ASK_USER with a rewritten query
ambiguity after the retry limit returns ASK_USER without another rewritten query

trace_contract: M-03 AGENT_ACTION_PROPOSAL records the Agent-selected action, target, confidence, and concise reason
M-03 PYTHON_GUARD records ACCEPTED or ESCALATED, materialized fields, final action, and policy reason
M-04 EXECUTION_OBSERVATION records the task readback and expected-result comparison
raw chain-of-thought and secrets are not stored or displayed
limitations: Results cover defined synthetic and deidentified cases and do not represent production mailbox-wide accuracy.
The Agent selects an intended action; Python retains execution authority and may escalate unsafe proposals.
Mail reply drafting and sending, Outlook, company authentication, and server operation remain Post-MVP.
